name: Integrations
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Integrations.
Native storefront and Shopify forms do not require an external endpoint. Only configure optional third-party destinations when you have a working service and understand which data it receives.
Leave unused social URLs empty. A social link does not embed a feed or connect an account.
Do not paste private keys into theme settings. Public map or CAPTCHA keys require appropriate service and domain restrictions.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Allow legacy custom code
settings.info: Controls the three code fields below. Existing code stays enabled for compatibility. These fields run trusted HTML/JavaScript without consent handling. Prefer app embeds; configure tracking through Shopify pixels.
settings.how: Turn on “Allow legacy custom code” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Legacy custom code: head
settings.info: Advanced: trusted code only. Runs on storefront pages, including Theme Editor previews. Never paste secrets. This is not a pixel or consent manager. Blank or none outputs nothing.
settings.how: Advanced legacy integration slot. Prefer an app embed or native section. Only add code you own or trust; never enter credentials. Leave the default none when unused. The Allow legacy custom code switch controls these slots.

settings.label: Form consent metadata
settings.info: Sends metadata to configured form handlers only. Does not add a checkbox, opt a customer in, or change Shopify tracking consent. Newsletter confirmation remains explicit.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for form consent metadata. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Bulk-order default destination
settings.info: Only used by Bulk order when its destination is Global default. Both legacy custom choices post to the configured endpoint; they do not render HTML or Liquid. Other forms own their destination.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for bulk-order default destination. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.

settings.label: Custom form CAPTCHA default
settings.info: Used only when a custom-endpoint form inherits this choice. Explicit section choices, including None, win. Shopify protects its native forms separately. Your server must verify custom tokens.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for custom form captcha default. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.

settings.label: Public CAPTCHA site key
settings.info: For the selected global provider. Section keys and retained provider-specific legacy keys take priority. Enter a public browser site key only; keep verification secrets on your server. Blank or none disables the key.
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.

settings.label: Default hidden tags
settings.info: Base tags for supported forms; section tags are appended. Tags do not subscribe customers or configure an external app.
settings.how: Enter the default hidden tags. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Default custom endpoint (optional)
settings.info: HTTPS or store-relative POST endpoint for custom forms. Local destinations take priority. Configure validation, token verification, consent and delivery on your server. Never include secrets in this URL.
settings.how: Enter the default custom endpoint (optional). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.

settings.label: Enable optional Google maps loader
settings.info: Locator sections also require their local map switch and a public key. Enabling loads Google automatically. This is not visitor consent. Review provider privacy requirements; native location cards work without Google.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable optional Google maps loader” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.

settings.label: Google maps API key (public)
settings.info: Public browser key for enabled locator sections. Restrict it to your storefront and required APIs with Google. Never enter a server secret.
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.

settings.label: Map banner fallback zoom
settings.info: Fallback for the Service area map banner when its local zoom is missing. Locator sections use their own zoom.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust map banner fallback zoom. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Facebook page URL
settings.info: Profile destination, not a live feed or tracking integration. Use an HTTP(S) URL. Explicit block links take priority; unsafe destinations are ignored.
settings.how: Enter the facebook page url. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
